title: An attacker used two compromised Qubole IAM users to assume roles that customers had granted Qubole, then emptied Secrets Manager, SSM and S3 across dozens of AWS accounts. Third-party cross-account trust is the attack path, not AWS itself.

Claude Fable 5.2 takes #1 on independent leaderboards (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 65 vs Gemini 4 Carbon 60), but cost per task rose ~31% on SemiAnalysis's GDPx despite cheaper tokens — effort level now matters as much as model choice.
